notification.reminder: Open Adhan Times to keep getting prayer notifications

today.title: Today
today.travelBody: Prayer times are still set for {{saved}}

highLats.title: High latitudes
highLats.hint: Far from the equator, twilight can last all night in summer, so Fajr and Isha angles never happen. This picks how they're set on those nights.
highLats.NightMiddleDetail: Fajr and Isha are no further than half the night from sunset and sunrise
highLats.AngleBasedDetail: A share of the night set by the method's angle (angle / 60)
highLats.OneSeventhDetail: Isha a seventh of the night after sunset, Fajr a seventh before sunrise

setup.locationHint: Prayer times depend on where you are. Your location stays on this phone.
setup.notFound: Couldn't find “{{query}}”. Try adding the country.
setup.methodHint: Methods use different sun angles for Fajr and Isha. Use the one your local mosque follows.
setup.asrHint: Hanafi Asr starts when shadows are twice an object's length; the others (Shafi‘i, Maliki, Hanbali) when they're the same length.
setup.asrStandardDetail: Shafi‘i, Maliki, Hanbali. Shadow equal to the object
setup.asrHanafiDetail: Shadow twice the object. Later Asr
setup.reviewHint: Check these against your mosque's timetable. You can change any of this later in Settings.
setup.notifyHint: Next, allow notifications to get the adhan at each prayer time.
setup.liveActivityHint: A countdown on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island in the hour before each prayer. You can change it later in Settings.

adjust.title: Adjust times
adjust.hint: Add or remove minutes to match your local mosque. Notifications and widgets use the adjusted times.

travel.title: You're in {{city}}
travel.needsAlwaysBody: Travel alerts check your location in the background. Allow it in Settings: Location → Always.

widget.ringHint: Time left to the next prayer, as a ring.

timetable.title: Prayer times · {{month}}
timetable.hint: A PDF to print, save or send

siri.current: It's {{prayer}} time. It ends at {{end}}, in {{left}}.
siri.none: It's not a prayer time now. {{prayer}} is at {{time}}, in {{left}}.

qibla.title: Qibla
qibla.calibrateBody: Move your phone in a figure 8 a few times, away from metal.
qibla.noCompassBody: Face {{deg}}° from north. Use a compass or a landmark you know.
qibla.deniedBody: The compass needs location permission to find true north and point to the qibla. The direction and distance below are for your saved location.
qibla.tip: Hold the phone flat, away from metal and magnets.

exactAlarm.title: On-time adhan
exactAlarm.body: Android can deliver the adhan late unless Adhan Times may set exact alarms. Turn on “Alarms & reminders”.
exactAlarm.settingsHint: Off: the adhan can be late
